A genuine category killer brought by one of the most respected domain investors still active.
David Castello has been building and monetizing premium .coms since the mid-90s. He and his brother turned PalmSprings.com from a $300/year asset into something generating $448k in twelve months. They sold Whisky.com for $3.1M. Their portfolio includes Nashville.com, Cost.com, GolfClub.com, Traveler.com and more. In 2009 he was inducted into the Domain Name Hall of Fame.
Today at 3 PM UTC he’s doing a live AMA in Doma Discord before Smoothie.com goes onchain.

How to build category-killer .com brands that compound instead of just get flipped
